sources.name: ASDiv
sources.licenseNote: CC BY-NC 4.0: nonkomersial. Dipakai hanya di server keluarga ini, tidak dimasukkan ke repo.
sources.attribution: Miao, Liang, dan Su (2020), A Diverse Corpus for Evaluating and Developing English Math Word Problem Solvers, Academia Sinica.
sources.notes: Soal cerita Math berlabel kelas 1 sampai 6, dengan kunci dari penyusun.

sources.name: GSM8K
sources.attribution: Cobbe dkk. (2021), Training Verifiers to Solve Math Word Problems, OpenAI. Lisensi MIT.
sources.notes: Hanya soal mudah yang dipakai: sedikit langkah, bilangan kecil, jawaban bilangan bulat.

sources.name: ARC Easy
sources.licenseNote: CC BY-SA 4.0: dipakai hanya di server keluarga ini, tidak dimasukkan ke repo.
sources.attribution: Clark dkk. (2018), Think you have Solved Question Answering? Try ARC, Allen Institute for AI.
sources.notes: Pilihan ganda Science dari ujian negara bagian AS kelas 3 sampai 9. Kelas diambil dari kode soal, yang di bawah kelas 3 atau di atas kelas 6 dilewati.

sources.name: OpenBookQA
sources.licenseNote: Repositori resmi allenai/OpenBookQA berlisensi Apache 2.0. Kartu dataset di Hugging Face menulis lisensi belum diketahui, jadi tutor mengecek soal sebelum dipakai.
sources.attribution: Mihaylov dkk. (2018), Can a Suit of Armor Conduct Electricity? OpenBookQA, Allen Institute for AI.
sources.notes: Fakta Science tingkat SD dalam bentuk pilihan ganda. Tanpa label kelas, jadi dipetakan ke kelas 4.

sources.name: Open Trivia DB
sources.licenseNote: CC BY-SA 4.0: dipakai hanya di server keluarga ini, tidak dimasukkan ke repo.
sources.attribution: Open Trivia DB (opentdb.com), disusun oleh komunitas.
sources.notes: Hanya tingkat mudah dan kategori yang aman untuk anak: Pengetahuan Umum, Sains dan Alam, Geografi, Hewan. Pengetahuan Umum disimpan tanpa skill untuk Arena Pengetahuan.

sources.name: Bebras (tugas berlisensi)
sources.licenseNote: Tugas Bebras berlisensi CC BY-SA per tugas. Importer hanya menerima berkas yang menulis lisensinya, dan tutor tetap menyetujui tiap soal.
sources.attribution: Bebras International Challenge on Informatics and Computational Thinking.
sources.notes: Tidak ada unduhan massal yang stabil. Admin menaruh berkas JSON tugas di KIRA_DATA_DIR/sources/bebras, satu tugas per berkas (lihat apps/worker/src/sourcing/datasets/bebras.ts).

sources.name: IKMC (Kangaroo Math), paper resmi
sources.licenseNote: Hak cipta penyelenggara. Cek apakah penyelenggara memberi unduhan gratis; kalau tidak, tutor mengunggah PDF milik keluarga.
sources.attribution: International Kangaroo Math Contest, Association Kangourou sans Frontieres.
sources.notes: Impor lewat Impor paket resmi. Paper tinggal di server keluarga, tidak masuk repo.

sources.name: IKSC (Kangaroo Science), paper resmi
sources.licenseNote: Hak cipta penyelenggara. Tutor mengunggah PDF milik keluarga.
sources.attribution: International Kangaroo Science Contest, Surya Institute.
sources.notes: Pustaka paper Science kelas 2 tipis, jadi pemilih paper memakai Paper gaya lomba buatan Kira bila perlu.

sources.name: SASMO, paper resmi
sources.licenseNote: Buku paper SASMO dijual. Keluarga membeli bukunya, tutor mengunggah PDF milik keluarga.
sources.attribution: Singapore and Asian Schools Math Olympiad, SIMCC.
sources.notes: Tandai unggah manual. Tidak pernah diambil otomatis.

sources.name: SEAMO, paper resmi
sources.licenseNote: Paper dijual penyelenggara. Tutor mengunggah PDF milik keluarga.
sources.notes: Tandai unggah manual.

sources.name: Cambridge Primary Checkpoint, contoh paper
sources.licenseNote: Contoh paper ada di situs resmi, sebagian butuh akun sekolah. Tidak diambil otomatis; tutor mengunggah PDF yang sah dipakai keluarga.
sources.notes: Dicatat sebagai calon sumber.

sources.name: Kangourou des mathematiques - sujets et solutions (France), niveau Ecolier
sources.licenseNote: Copyright ACL - Les Editions du Kangourou; PDFs linked openly, no explicit reuse licence stated
sources.attribution: ACL - Les Editions du Kangourou (Kangourou Sans Frontieres member)
sources.notes: French language; pictorial/logic questions, usable for grades 3-5 with translation. Level e covers French CE2-CM2 (about Indonesian kelas 3-5). Archive index pages: https://www.mathkang.org/concours/toutk{YYYY}.html. No Pre-Ecolier (grade 1-2) level in France. Petunjuk ambil: https://www.mathkang.org/pdf/kangourou{YYYY}e.pdf (e = Ecolier CE2-CM2; b = Benjamin 6e-5e). YYYY 2015..2026 return 200...

sources.name: IKMC past papers 2005-2023 (Pre-Ecolier, Ecolier, Benjamin and higher)
sources.licenseNote: All rights reserved by Kangaroo Pakistan; published openly for download, no reuse licence stated
sources.notes: English, official IKMC paper set. Best free source for IKMC Pre-Ecolier (grades 1-2), Ecolier (3-4), Benjamin (5-6) in English. 2023 verified (PDF 200); 2015 page lists hashed PDF names. Answer key file present at least for 2023; check other years. Kunci jawaban ada di PDF terpisah (Answer Key), jadi AI mengerjakan soal dua kali dan mengusulkan kunci; tutor tetap memilih kuncinya.

sources.name: Math Kangaroo USA - free sample questions 2006-2026
sources.licenseNote: Copyright 2003-2026 Math Kangaroo USA NFP Inc., all rights reserved; free to download, redistribution not permitted
sources.notes: Sample (subset) of each year's questions across all grade bands; solutions only in the store. Questions are the standard IKMC pool translated to US English. Petunjuk ambil: https://mathkangaroo.org/mks/wp-content/uploads/YYYY/MM/YYYY-MK-Sample-Questions.pdf (folder and filename vary; scrape hrefs from the page, 22 PDFs found; 2026 = /2026/04/2026-MK-Sample-Questions.pdf)

sources.name: Math Kangaroo USA - full past exams with solutions, grades 1-2 to 5-6
sources.licenseNote: Copyright Math Kangaroo USA, all rights reserved
sources.notes: Page offers past exam PDFs 2005-2026 with written solutions plus online practice exams; only the 2010 and 2020 online exams and the 2015 and 2025 PDF exams are free. Same pages exist for grades-3-4 and grades-5-6 under /mks/practice/. Tutor must buy or upload.

sources.name: Mathe-Kaenguru Aufgaben (Klassen 3-4, 5-6)
sources.licenseNote: Copyright Mathe-Kaenguru e.V.; PDFs openly downloadable, no reuse licence stated
sources.notes: German language. Same IKMC question pool, many picture-based. Solutions may be in a separate file or the participant booklet; not verified. Petunjuk ambil: https://www.mathe-kaenguru.de/chronik/aufgaben/downloads/kaenguru{YYYY}_34.pdf (Klassen 3-4) and kaenguru{YYYY}_56.pdf (Klassen 5-6); YYYY 2020..2026 listed; kaenguru2026_34.pdf verified 200 application/pdf

sources.name: Kangur Matematyczny - testy konkursowe (Zaczek, Maluch, Beniamin)
sources.licenseNote: Copyright Kangur Matematyczny; PDFs openly downloadable, no reuse licence stated
sources.attribution: Stowarzyszenie na rzecz Edukacji Matematycznej (Kangur Matematyczny, Poland)
sources.notes: Polish language. Category-to-grade mapping uses Polish school grades, not Indonesian; Zaczek is roughly IKMC Pre-Ecolier/Ecolier. Petunjuk ambil: https://www.kangur-mat.pl/dokumenty/testy/{YYYY}/{z|m|b|k|j|s}_{YYYY}.pdf (z = Zaczek, m = Maluch, b = Beniamin; z_2024.pdf and m_2023.pdf verified 200 application/pdf). Answers e.g. https://www.kangur-mat.pl/dokumenty/odpowiedzi2026.pdf

sources.name: Kangourou Italia - testi e soluzioni delle finali (Ecolier, Benjamin)
sources.licenseNote: Copyright Kangourou Italia; PDFs openly downloadable, no reuse licence stated
sources.notes: Italian language, finals (harder than the qualifying round) with solutions. Petunjuk ambil: Scrape hrefs on the home page containing testifinale. Examples (200 application/pdf): /testifinale/2026/F2026-Ecolier-testi-e-soluzioni.pdf, /testifinale/2022/Finale individuale 2022 - ecolier testi e soluzioni.pdf (URL-encode spaces), /testifinale/2023/Ecolier2023RFIN.pdf

sources.name: Kengura uzduotys 2000-2008 (LT/PL/RU, with ATS answer files)
sources.licenseNote: Copyright Kengura Lithuania; no reuse licence stated
sources.notes: Only old papers are on the listing page; low priority. Uppercase .PDF extension. Petunjuk ambil: https://www.kengura.lt/uzduotys/{YYYY}{LT|PL|RU|ATS}.PDF (YYYY 2000..2008; 2019 returned 404)

sources.name: Math Kangaroo India - past year papers (E-Book) 2014-2023
sources.licenseNote: Site states no part of its content may be copied without prior written consent
sources.notes: Page is titled E-Book with grade bands 1-2 up to 11-12; could not confirm whether download is free or paid, so left unknown. Mock tests live on a separate registration-based site.

sources.name: SOF IMO (International Mathematics Olympiad) sample papers class 1-12
sources.licenseNote: Copyright 2024 Science Olympiad Foundation, all rights reserved; sample papers openly downloadable
sources.notes: Class 1-3 are the priority. Indian curriculum alignment; one sample paper per class only (previous-year papers are sold via mtg.in, see sof-previous-year-papers-mtg). Answer key not confirmed inside the PDF.

sources.name: SOF IEO (International English Olympiad) sample papers class 1-12
sources.licenseNote: Copyright 2024 Science Olympiad Foundation, all rights reserved; sample papers openly downloadable
sources.notes: Reading, grammar, vocabulary, spoken and written expression; written for Indian English-medium schools. No audio.

sources.name: SOF NSO / ISO (National then International Science Olympiad) sample papers cl...
sources.licenseNote: Copyright 2024 Science Olympiad Foundation, all rights reserved; sample papers openly downloadable
sources.notes: NSO was renamed ISO; page title says ISO but URLs keep nso. Includes logical reasoning and achiever section.

sources.name: SOF IGKO (International General Knowledge Olympiad) sample papers class 1-10
sources.licenseNote: Copyright 2024 Science Olympiad Foundation, all rights reserved; sample papers openly downloadable
sources.notes: General knowledge with India-centric content (Indian geography and culture); filter before use for an Indonesian child. Petunjuk ambil: https://sofworld.org/igko/class-{n}/sample-model-test-papers/igko-sample-papers-class-{n} -> /download/file/fid/{N}. fids class 1-6: 73701,73702,73703,73704,73705,73706 (class 1 verified application/pdf)

sources.name: SOF ICSO (International Cyber Olympiad) sample papers class 1-10
sources.licenseNote: Copyright 2024 Science Olympiad Foundation, all rights reserved; sample papers openly downloadable
sources.notes: Computer fundamentals plus logical reasoning and achiever section; useful for the logic/computational-thinking track. Petunjuk ambil: https://sofworld.org/icso/class-{n}/sample-model-test-papers/icso-sample-papers-class-{n} -> /download/file/fid/{N}. fids class 1-6: 73668,73669,73920,73921,73922,73673 (class 1 verified application/pdf)

sources.name: SOF previous-year olympiad papers (sold via MTG)
sources.licenseNote: Commercial book, all rights reserved
sources.attribution: Science Olympiad Foundation / MTG Learning Media
sources.notes: SOF home page promotes previous-year papers for sale on mtg.in; the shop itself was not opened or checked. Tutor must buy or upload.
